summary: Push C day. No composed chicken entree on the menu today, so lunch leans on scaled-up Herb Marinated Chicken Breast for the main protein, while dinner brings in Bourbon Barbecue Turkey Breast for variety. Pre-workout uses the wellness-bar Berry Cottage Cheese Smoothie.

meals.name: Uber Breakfast
meals.note: Turkey and eggs for protein, oats and multigrain bread for carbs, fruit for fiber.

meals.name: Uber HQ Lunch
meals.note: No composed chicken entree today, so extra herb-marinated chicken breast anchors a burrito-bowl style plate with rice, beans, broccoli and avocado.

meals.name: Uber Pre-workout
meals.note: Wellness-bar protein smoothie plus banana for quick, low-fat carbs before lifting.

meals.name: Uber Post-workout / Dinner
meals.note: Bourbon barbecue turkey breast for variety, over whole grain pasta and broccoli with walnuts, to hit post-workout protein, carb and fat targets.
